A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was an [[Alderaanian consular security]] [[soldier]], better known as a '''fleet trooper'''. At the end of the [[Battle of Scarif]], he downloaded the [[Death Star plans]] onto a [[datacard]] and attempted to bring it onto the ''[[Tantive IV]]''. However, the trooper and almost a dozen others found themselves trapped behind a partly opened security door and were soon intercepted by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. The trooper desperately handed the datacard through the gap in the door to [[Second officer]] [[Toshma Jefkin]], and was fatally impaled by Vader as the dark lord continued pursuing the datacard.

==Biography==
===Sacrifice aboard the ''Profundity''===
{{Quote|Help us!|The fleet trooper, calling for help beyond the immobilized security door|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:NoEscape-WotF.png|thumb|right|250px|The fleet trooper trapped with Darth Vader]]
The individual joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] before or during [[1 BBY]], where he became an [[Alderaanian consular security]] [[soldier]], better known as a [[fleet]] [[trooper]]. He was stationed aboard the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'' during the [[Battle of Scarif]], the battle that assured the theft of the [[Death Star plans]]. At the end of the battle, the ''Profundity'' attempted to escape with the other ships when the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' arrived and disabled the [[cruiser]]. The fleet troopers aboard the ''Profundity'' began evacuating onto the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', which was docked in the cruisers hanger.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Whilst the other troopers ran to the next security door, the individual stopped at a terminal where he downloaded the Death Star plans onto a [[datacard]]. As he did that, another trooper told him to hurry and they ran down to the next security door. The trooper attempted to open it when a power surge disabled everything around them, leaving the door only partly opened. The troopers started pulling the door to get someone through and the trooper knocked on it, calling to the soldiers on the other side. However, the troopers stopped as they heard something behind them. As they pointed their guns towards the darkness, a deep breathing sound became clear to them and the area in front of them was lit up to reveal [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] activating his [[Darth Vader's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. A trooper ordered them to open fire and a firefight ensued.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:Death_of_a_crewmate.png|thumb|left|250px|The trooper is killed by Darth Vader.]]
Vader began picking off the rebels and the trooper began banging on the security door for help. The [[Second officer]] of the ''Tantive IV'', [[Toshma Jefkin]] came to his aid on the other side and tried to pull the door open. As Vader swiftly approached, one of the remaining men took the troopers gun and confronted Vader, only to be [[Force choke]]d and thrown aside. The trooper then reached through the gap in the door and gave the datacard to Jefkin. Jefkin ran towards the ''Tantive IV'' and Vader dug his lightsaber into the trooper, using the Force to open the door. Jefkin ran into the corvette and close the door as Vader cut through some other troopers trying to slow him. He then ordered the corvette to launch and the ''Tantive IV'' flew out the hanger and escaped the system.<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|That… thing. In the hallway, while we were trying to get off the ''Profundity''. It killed at least a dozen of my men, cut them down like they were nothing. Blasters had no effect, it just kept on coming, kept on killing. It was like… like a nightmare. I've never seen anything like it, like some kind of death angel.|Toshma Jefkin, to Raymus Antilles, on Darth Vader killing Rebel troops, including the unidentified fleet trooper|<ref name="Raymus">{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>}}
[[File:OriginalTrilogy-DeathStarexplosion.png|thumb|right|300px|The plans on the fleet trooper's datacard led to the destruction of the Death Star]]
After making it aboard the ''Tantive IV'', Jefkin gave the fleet trooper's datacard, with the Death Star plans on it, to [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]], who gave it to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> When the ''Tantive IV'' was [[Secret mission to Tatooine|intercepted]], Organa put the datacard into an [[astromech droid]] known as [[R2-D2]], which escaped the [[corvette]]. The astromech then eventually made it back to the Alliance at [[Yavin 4]] and they planned an attack on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. The attack became known as the [[Battle of Yavin]] and was a complete success, ensuring the Death Star's destruction in just under thirty [[standard minute]]s.<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Despite having a central role in the one scene they're in and having several speaking lines, the character was portrayed by an uncredited actor in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" />
